package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"

	"gorm.io/gorm/clause"
)

// scenario for gorm_locking_clauses_built_outside_repository: `FOR UPDATE` or similar locking behavior built in handlers or services instead of repository-owned methods.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type Rule060PositiveRecord struct {
	ID       int
	TenantID int
	Balance  float64
}

func scenario060Positive(db *gorm.DB, accountID int) (*Rule060PositiveRecord, error) {
	var record Rule060PositiveRecord
	if err := db.Clauses(clause.Locking{Strength: "UPDATE"}).Where("id = ?", accountID).First(&record).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &record, nil
}
